description: SwiftUI implementation of a calculator interface with associated view model logic, handling user input, display updates, and basic arithmetic operations.

classes.name: CalculatorViewModel
classes.description: ObservableObject managing calculator state, logic for computing operations, and user interactions.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Handles user interaction with calculator buttons, dispatching logic based on button type.

methods.name: inputDigit
methods.description: Handles input of digit buttons, updating display accordingly.

methods.name: inputDecimal
methods.description: Handles input of decimal point, managing number formatting.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets calculator state to initial values.

methods.name: toggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the current number.

methods.name: percent
methods.description: Converts the current number to a percentage.

methods.name: setOperation
methods.description: Sets the pending arithmetic operation, evaluating previous if necessary.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Performs calculation based on the stored operation and operands.

methods.name: updateSecondary
methods.description: Updates the secondary display with current operand and operation.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a Double value into a user-friendly string.
